summary: Collective Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K (Items 3.02/8.01/9.01) on June 17, 2026, reporting the completion of its IPO and related private placements as previously disclosed. The IPO of 22 million units at $10/unit raised $220M gross, with an over-allotment option for up to 3.3 million additional units. Simultaneously, a private placement of 5.8375 million warrants at $0.80/warrant to the sponsor raised $4.67M gross, and 165,000 representative shares were issued to underwriters under Rule 4(a)(2). This is a routine disclosure of completed capital-raising events, not a special situation. No action, recommendation, or structural change is described; the filing merely confirms previously reported closings.
